belief: The recognized inventors of the airplane are Orville Wright and Wilbur Wright (the Wright brothers), who achieved the first controlled, sustained, powered flight on December 17, 1903.

author: worker_2
belief: The recognized inventors of the internet are Vinton Cerf and Robert Kahn, who are widely known as the "fathers of the Internet" for designing the TCP/IP protocols.

author: worker_3
belief: The recognized inventor of the personal computer is Ed Roberts (Henry Edward Roberts), who is widely known as "the father of the personal computer" for inventing the Altair 8800 in 1974, the first commercially successful personal computer.

author: worker_4
belief: The recognized inventor of the mobile phone is Martin Cooper, who made the first public call from a handheld portable cell phone on April 3, 1973, while working at Motorola. He is widely regarded as the "father of the (handheld) cell phone."

author: worker_4
belief: The recognized inventor of the digital camera is Steven Sasson, who developed the first self-contained (portable) digital camera at Kodak in 1975.
